# CI Instruction Index

This ignored instruction index gives the standalone CI checkout complete routing
coverage without turning project-local instructions into canonical source.

## Rules

- Load `architecture.md`, `shared/debugging.md`,
  `shared/delivery-hygiene.md`, `shared/documentation-runbooks.md`,
  `shared/maintainability.md`, `shared/migrations.md`,
  `shared/performance-observability.md`, `shared/security-observability.md`,
  `shared/security.md`, `shared/testing.md`, and `shared/wcag.md` for canonical
  guidance health checks.
